key: VICTORIA: I finally found you.
en: VICTORIA: I finally found you.
ja: ヴィクトリア: やっと見つけた。

key: Turn and face me!
en: Turn and face me!
ja: こっちを向いて、わたしと向き合いなさい!

key: SOLARIS: State your business, squealing pup.
en: SOLARIS: State your business, squealing pup.
ja: ソラリス: 用件を言え、ほえる子犬よ。

key: VICTORIA: I'm here to end you!
en: VICTORIA: I'm here to end you!
ja: ヴィクトリア: あなたを終わらせに来た!

key: SOLARIS: As so many try to,
en: SOLARIS: As so many try to,
ja: ソラリス: 多くの者が試みたようにな、

key: Pointlessly.
en: Pointlessly.
ja: 無意味に。

key: VICTORIA: You'll regret looking down on me!
en: VICTORIA: You'll regret looking down on me!
ja: ヴィクトリア: わたしを見下したこと、後悔させてやる!

key: SOLARIS: There are many things I regret, child.
en: SOLARIS: There are many things I regret, child.
ja: ソラリス: 後悔していることなら山ほどある、小娘よ。

key: One more would be nothing to me.
en: One more would be nothing to me.
ja: もう一つ増えたところで、私にとっては大したことではない。

key: But I do not say it is pointless for the sake of insulting whatever ability you may or may not have.
en: But I do not say it is pointless for the sake of insulting whatever ability you may or may not have.
ja: だが、無意味だと言ったのは、貴様の力量を侮辱するためではない。

key: It is pointless because it is inevitable.
en: It is pointless because it is inevitable.
ja: 無意味なのは、それが避けられないことだからだ。

key: You are here for your teacher, are you not?
en: You are here for your teacher, are you not?
ja: 貴様はここに、恩師のために来たのではないか?

key: VICTORIA: Her name was Kiki.
en: VICTORIA: Her name was Kiki.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 彼女の名前はキキ。

key: You stole her from a world that never even knew how desperately it needed her.
en: You stole her from a world that never even knew how desperately it needed her.
ja: あなたは、彼女をどれだけ必要としていたかすら知らないこの世界から、彼女を奪った。

key: SOLARIS: You need not be shy.
en: SOLARIS: You need not be shy.
ja: ソラリス: 遠慮する必要はない。

key: The world is not the one who needed her; you are.
en: The world is not the one who needed her; you are.
ja: 彼女を必要としていたのは世界ではない。貴様だ。

key: But if you were not here for your--
en: But if you were not here for your--
ja: だが、もし貴様がその者のためにここに来たのでなければ――

key: For Kiki,
en: For Kiki,
ja: キキのためでなければ、

key: It would be another for his sister,
en: It would be another for his sister,
ja: 誰か別の者は妹のために、

key: Or a lady for her mother.
en: Or a lady for her mother.
ja: またある女は母のために来ただろう。

key: The names, the relations...
en: The names, the relations...
ja: 名前も、関係も…

key: They matter not to the outcome.
en: They matter not to the outcome.
ja: 結末には関係がない。

key: My regrets are many.
en: My regrets are many.
ja: 私の後悔は数多い。

key: VICTORIA: Don't pretend that you regret the things you've done after doing them without a second's hesitation!
en: VICTORIA: Don't pretend that you regret the things you've done after doing them without a second's hesitation!
ja: ヴィクトリア: 一瞬もためらわずにやったくせに、後悔してるふりなんてしないで!

key: SOLARIS: I do not regret doing them.
en: SOLARIS: I do not regret doing them.
ja: ソラリス: やったことを後悔しているわけではない。

key: I regret that I had to.
en: I regret that I had to.
ja: そうせざるを得なかったことを、後悔している。

key: VICTORIA: Your choices are your own, and you alone will answer for them.
en: VICTORIA: Your choices are your own, and you alone will answer for them.
ja: ヴィクトリア: あなたの選択はあなた自身のもの。その責任を負うのもあなた一人よ。

key: SOLARIS: That may be so.
en: SOLARIS: That may be so.
ja: ソラリス: そうかもしれん。

key: But are you not the same?
en: But are you not the same?
ja: だが、貴様も同じではないのか?

key: VICTORIA: Don't insult me like that.
en: VICTORIA: Don't insult me like that.
ja: ヴィクトリア: そんな言い方でわたしを侮辱しないで。

key: SOLARIS: We do not know each other, but I am reasonably confident that chasing old men for the sake of revenge is not your choice of hobby.
en: SOLARIS: We do not know each other, but I am reasonably confident that chasing old men for the sake of revenge is not your choice of hobby.
ja: ソラリス: 互いに知らぬ仲だが、ふくしゅうのために老人を追いかけることが貴様の趣味だとは、まず思えん。

key: VICTORIA: It's not my hobby; it's my responsibility.
en: VICTORIA: It's not my hobby; it's my responsibility.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 趣味じゃない。わたしの責任。

key: You-- Team Meteor...
en: You-- Team Meteor...
ja: あなたたち――チームメテオは…

key: All of you have caused so many people to suffer!
en: All of you have caused so many people to suffer!
ja: あなたたち全員が、あまりに多くの人を苦しめてきた!

key: Taking you out is what's best for the world!
en: Taking you out is what's best for the world!
ja: あなたを排除することが、世界にとって最善なの!

key: SOLARIS: Still blaming your feelings on the world...
en: SOLARIS: Still blaming your feelings on the world...
ja: ソラリス: それでもまだ、自分の感情を世界のせいにするのか…

key: VICTORIA: It will be best for me too.
en: VICTORIA: It will be best for me too.
ja: ヴィクトリア: わたしにとっても最善のはず。

key: SOLARIS: That's right.
en: SOLARIS: That's right.
ja: ソラリス: その通りだ。

key: Whatever helps you sleep at night.
en: Whatever helps you sleep at night.
ja: 夜眠れるようになるなら、何だっていい。

key: Whatever eases the guilt.
en: Whatever eases the guilt.
ja: 罪悪感が和らぐなら、何だっていい。

key: Why couldn't I be strong enough?
en: Why couldn't I be strong enough?
ja: なぜ私は十分に強くなれなかったのか?

key: Why couldn't I be there for them?
en: Why couldn't I be there for them?
ja: なぜ私は彼らのそばにいてやれなかったのか?

key: Why is it this world is one that is set on ripping people apart?
en: Why is it this world is one that is set on ripping people apart?
ja: なぜこの世界は、人々を引き裂くようにできているのか?

key: Nothing is fair,
en: Nothing is fair,
ja: 何一つ公平ではない、

key: But oughtn't someone do something about that?
en: But oughtn't someone do something about that?
ja: だが、誰かがそれに手を打つべきではないのか?

key: VICTORIA: What are you saying...
en: VICTORIA: What are you saying...
ja: ヴィクトリア: 何を言って…

key: SOLARIS: We are not so different, child.
en: SOLARIS: We are not so different, child.
ja: ソラリス: 我々はさほど違わぬ、小娘よ。

key: I remember my parents fondly.
en: I remember my parents fondly.
ja: 私は両親を懐かしく思い出す。

key: I remember the feelings I earned in losing them.
en: I remember the feelings I earned in losing them.
ja: 彼らを失って得た感情を、私は覚えている。

key: I remember the feelings I lost when I stood over the one who took them from me,
en: I remember the feelings I lost when I stood over the one who took them from me,
ja: 彼らを奪った者の前に立った時、私が失った感情もまた覚えている、

key: Or what was left of him.
en: Or what was left of him.
ja: あるいは、彼の成れの果ての前で。

key: I did not have the luxury of making revenge my purpose.
en: I did not have the luxury of making revenge my purpose.
ja: ふくしゅうを目的にするようなぜいたくは、私には許されなかった。

key: But I had a responsibility to do what I could to make the world the better place that my parents had always tried to.
en: But I had a responsibility to do what I could to make the world the better place that my parents had always tried to.
ja: だが、両親がずっと目指していたような、より良い世界にするために、できることをする責任が私にはあった。

key: And if the world were sure to not pull any punches, then why should I?
en: And if the world were sure to not pull any punches, then why should I?
ja: そしてこの世界が容赦なく殴りかかってくるというなら、なぜ私だけが手加減する必要がある?

key: SOLARIS: As you can see, I have failed wonderfully.
en: SOLARIS: As you can see, I have failed wonderfully.
ja: ソラリス: 見ての通り、私は見事に失敗した。

key: So, this was inevitable,
en: So, this was inevitable,
ja: だから、これは避けられないことだった、

key: Be it by the hand of one who lost their light to me, or the hand of she who I lost my hand to.
en: Be it by the hand of one who lost their light to me, or the hand of she who I lost my hand to.
ja: 私によって光を奪われた者の手であれ、私が手を奪われた彼女の手であれ。

key: SOLARIS: If you truly believe that this is the path you must take, then take it freely.
en: SOLARIS: If you truly believe that this is the path you must take, then take it freely.
ja: ソラリス: 貴様が本当にこれが進むべき道だと信じるなら、心のままに進むがいい。

key: I will not survive a fall from this height.
en: I will not survive a fall from this height.
ja: この高さから落ちれば、私は生き延びられまい。

key: A stiff breeze could do the job, if you so wanted it to.
en: A stiff breeze could do the job, if you so wanted it to.
ja: 貴様がそう望むなら、一陣の風でも事足りるだろう。

key: VICTORIA: ...
en: VICTORIA: ...
ja: ヴィクトリア: …

key: SOLARIS: Just as I thought, you don't have the will to go through with such a thing.
en: SOLARIS: Just as I thought, you don't have the will to go through with such a thing.
ja: ソラリス: 思った通り、貴様にはそんなことをやり遂げる意志はない。

key: You may make me the scapegoat for your feelings of grief and guilt as much as you like,
en: You may make me the scapegoat for your feelings of grief and guilt as much as you like,
ja: 貴様の悲しみと罪悪感の身代わりに、私をいくらでも仕立てるがいい、

key: But killing me will not absolve you of them.
en: But killing me will not absolve you of them.
ja: だが、私を殺したところで、それらから解放されはしない。

key: It will only relieve you of their container.
en: It will only relieve you of their container.
ja: ただ、その感情の入れ物を取り除くだけだ。

key: This, you must already know.
en: This, you must already know.
ja: それは、貴様自身すでにわかっているはずだ。

key: VICTORIA: Don't pretend you know me!
en: VICTORIA: Don't pretend you know me!
ja: ヴィクトリア: わたしのことを知ってるふりしないで!

key: SOLARIS: I know myself, and nothing more.
en: SOLARIS: I know myself, and nothing more.
ja: ソラリス: 私が知っているのは、私自身のことだけだ。

key: ???: Victoria!
en: ???: Victoria!
ja: ???: ヴィクトリア!

key: VICTORIA: What, Cal.
en: VICTORIA: What, Cal.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 何、キャル。

key: Are you here to try and talk me out of this too?
en: Are you here to try and talk me out of this too?
ja: あなたもわたしを止めに来たの?

key: CAL: No, I'm here to help you.
en: CAL: No, I'm here to help you.
ja: キャル: いや、助けに来たんだ。

key: Whatever that means.
en: Whatever that means.
ja: それがどういう意味であれ。

key: VICTORIA: And just what do you think that means, Cal?
en: VICTORIA: And just what do you think that means, Cal?
ja: ヴィクトリア: それがどういう意味だっていうの、キャル?

key: What can you possibly do?
en: What can you possibly do?
ja: あなたに何ができるっていうの?

key: CAL: ...
en: CAL: ...
ja: キャル: …

key: VICTORIA: What can anyone possibly do...
en: VICTORIA: What can anyone possibly do...
ja: ヴィクトリア: 誰に何ができるっていうの…

key: CAL: Does anyone ever know?
en: CAL: Does anyone ever know?
ja: キャル: 誰かにそれがわかったことなんて、あるのかな?

key: VICTORIA: Kiki would have known...
en: VICTORIA: Kiki would have known...
ja: ヴィクトリア: キキならわかってたはず…

key: CAL: What would Kiki have done?
en: CAL: What would Kiki have done?
ja: キャル: キキならどうしてた?

key: VICTORIA: Don't ask me that like I could possibly know!
en: VICTORIA: Don't ask me that like I could possibly know!
ja: ヴィクトリア: わたしにわかるみたいに聞かないで!

key: Thanks to SOMEONE, she isn't here anymore to tell us!
en: Thanks to SOMEONE, she isn't here anymore to tell us!
ja: 誰かさんのおかげで、もう彼女に聞くことすらできないんだから!

key: CAL: But the leader of Apophyll is still here.
en: CAL: But the leader of Apophyll is still here.
ja: キャル: でも、アポフィルの指導者は、まだここにいる。

key: VICTORIA: I am not Kiki.
en: VICTORIA: I am not Kiki.
ja: ヴィクトリア: わたしはキキじゃない。

key: Don't presume that I could be anywhere near her level!
en: Don't presume that I could be anywhere near her level!
ja: わたしが彼女に少しでも近いなんて、思わないで!

key: She was the purest soul this wretched world had ever seen.
en: She was the purest soul this wretched world had ever seen.
ja: 彼女は、この惨めな世界が見た中で最も純粋な魂だった。

key: CAL: And she chose you to succeed her.
en: CAL: And she chose you to succeed her.
ja: キャル: そして彼女は、君を後継者に選んだ。

key: VICTORIA: I CAN'T succeed her!
en: VICTORIA: I CAN'T succeed her!
ja: ヴィクトリア: わたしに彼女の後は継げない!

key: If I could, do you really think I would be here?!
en: If I could, do you really think I would be here?!
ja: できるんだったら、わたしが今こんなところにいると思う?!

key: CAL: The only reason you can say that is because you already know that being here is wrong.
en: CAL: The only reason you can say that is because you already know that being here is wrong.
ja: キャル: 君がそう言えるのは、ここにいることが間違いだって、もう自分でわかってるからだ。

key: Just as she would.
en: Just as she would.
ja: 彼女ならそう思うのと同じようにね。

key: CAL: Kiki was excellent at many things...
en: CAL: Kiki was excellent at many things...
ja: キャル: キキは色んなことが得意だった…

key: But keeping secrets was not one of them.
en: But keeping secrets was not one of them.
ja: でも、秘密を守るのは得意じゃなかった。

key: I heard about how she was struggling with her illness.
en: I heard about how she was struggling with her illness.
ja: 彼女が病気と闘ってたって話は聞いてた。

key: Her loss was inevitable,
en: Her loss was inevitable,
ja: 彼女を失うのは避けられないことだった、

key: As was your struggle to come to terms with it.
en: As was your struggle to come to terms with it.
ja: 君がそれを受け入れようと苦しむのもね。

key: Both of you had challenges to face, and much to learn.
en: Both of you had challenges to face, and much to learn.
ja: 君たち二人とも、向き合うべき試練があって、学ぶべきことがたくさんあった。

key: Everyone does, and everyone always will.
en: Everyone does, and everyone always will.
ja: 誰だってそうだし、これからもずっとそうだ。

key: But she chose you.
en: But she chose you.
ja: でも、彼女は君を選んだ。

key: She saw in you the same thing that she saw in herself when she decided to found that academy.
en: She saw in you the same thing that she saw in herself when she decided to found that academy.
ja: 彼女があのアカデミーを設立しようと決めた時に自分自身に見たものと、同じものを君に見たんだ。

key: She entrusted that place to you.
en: She entrusted that place to you.
ja: 彼女はあの場所を君に託した。

key: Are you going to tell her that she was wrong to do so?
en: Are you going to tell her that she was wrong to do so?
ja: それが間違いだったと、彼女に言うつもりなのか?

key: CAL: Or are you going to prove her right?
en: CAL: Or are you going to prove her right?
ja: キャル: それとも、彼女が正しかったと証明するのか?

key: VICTORIA: E-enough already...
en: VICTORIA: E-enough already...
ja: ヴィクトリア: も、もういい…

key: VICTORIA: I...
en: VICTORIA: I...
ja: ヴィクトリア: わたし…

key: I get it, okay?
en: I get it, okay?
ja: わかったから。

key: CAL: Let's go back.
en: CAL: Let's go back.
ja: キャル: 戻ろう。

key: You have no business staying here.
en: You have no business staying here.
ja: 君がここに残る理由はない。

key: SOLARIS: Hmm.
en: SOLARIS: Hmm.
ja: ソラリス: ふむ。

key: So that was Cal.
en: So that was Cal.
ja: あれがキャルか。

key: I suppose he is nothing like his brother said after all.
en: I suppose he is nothing like his brother said after all.
ja: 兄が言っていたのとは、まるで違うようだな。

key: Nevertheless.
en: Nevertheless.
ja: それはさておき。

key: I understand my fate well enough.
en: I understand my fate well enough.
ja: 自分の運命くらいは、十分理解している。

key: If it is not her, it will be another.
en: If it is not her, it will be another.
ja: 彼女でなくとも、他の誰かがやってくるだろう。

key: SOLARIS: Go freely.
en: SOLARIS: Go freely.
ja: ソラリス: 自由に行くがいい。

key: The outcome of our conflict was made clear in Agate.
en: The outcome of our conflict was made clear in Agate.
ja: 我々の争いの結末は、アゲートですでに明らかになっている。

key: We need not rehash it.
en: We need not rehash it.
ja: 蒸し返す必要はない。

key: I suspect that, despite her mercy, my time is at its end regardless.
en: I suspect that, despite her mercy, my time is at its end regardless.
ja: 彼女の慈悲があったとしても、私の時間はいずれにせよ終わりに近いのだろう。

key: Please create a world in line with your own ideals.
en: Please create a world in line with your own ideals.
ja: 貴様自身の理想に沿った世界を、作ってくれ。

key: The struggle to do so...
en: The struggle to do so...
ja: そのための苦闘こそ…

key: Perhaps that is the only meaning life has to offer.
en: Perhaps that is the only meaning life has to offer.
ja: それこそが、人生が与えてくれる唯一の意味なのかもしれん。

key: SOLARIS: I thought as much.
en: SOLARIS: I thought as much.
ja: ソラリス: そうだろうと思っていた。

key: I will not pretend to be capable of fighting you either.
en: I will not pretend to be capable of fighting you either.
ja: 貴様と戦えるふりをするつもりもない。

key: I understood that as soon as I had to resign to asking for your help, I had already forfeit everything.
en: I understood that as soon as I had to resign to asking for your help, I had already forfeit everything.
ja: 貴様に助けを求めざるを得なくなった時点で、私はすでにすべてを失っていたのだと理解していた。

key: I pieced together what happened to Ace as well.
en: I pieced together what happened to Ace as well.
ja: エースに何が起きたのかも、私なりにつなぎ合わせた。

key: I have but three questions for you, if you will grant me the kindness for them.
en: I have but three questions for you, if you will grant me the kindness for them.
ja: 貴様に三つ、質問がある。答えてくれるだけの慈悲があるならばだが。

key: Then I shall go in peace.
en: Then I shall go in peace.
ja: それが済めば、私は安らかに逝こう。

key: SOLARIS: I'll take your silence as tacit compliance.
en: SOLARIS: I'll take your silence as tacit compliance.
ja: ソラリス: その沈黙、暗黙の了承と受け取っておこう。

key: My first question...
en: My first question...
ja: 一つ目の質問だ…

key: When you first joined our team, were you already planning to make this happen?
en: When you first joined our team, were you already planning to make this happen?
ja: 貴様が初めて我々のチームに加わった時、すでにこうなることを計画していたのか?

key: Or was this simply the result of opportunism?
en: Or was this simply the result of opportunism?
ja: それとも、これは単なる日和見の結果に過ぎないのか?

key: LIN: The only thing better than a well-laid plan coming to fruition,
en: LIN: The only thing better than a well-laid plan coming to fruition,
ja: リン: よく練られた計画が実を結ぶことより良いものがあるとすれば、

key: Is a well-laid plan coming unraveled at the hand of impulse.
en: Is a well-laid plan coming unraveled at the hand of impulse.
ja: それは、よく練られた計画が衝動の手によって解けていくこと。

key: SOLARIS: I see.
en: SOLARIS: I see.
ja: ソラリス: なるほど。

key: Second question.
en: Second question.
ja: 二つ目の質問だ。

key: I understand your goal.
en: I understand your goal.
ja: 貴様の目的は理解している。

key: You will make the lie we promised others in order to manipulate them a reality, and create the New World.
en: You will make the lie we promised others in order to manipulate them a reality, and create the New World.
ja: 他者を操るために約束したうそを現実のものとし、新世界を作り出す、というものだろう。

key: But just what kind of world do you intend to create?
en: But just what kind of world do you intend to create?
ja: だが、貴様が作ろうとしているのは、一体どんな世界だ?

key: LIN: The only one where hope can exist.
en: LIN: The only one where hope can exist.
ja: リン: 希望が存在しうる、唯一の世界。

key: LIN: The only kind worth creating.
en: LIN: The only kind worth creating.
ja: リン: 作る価値のある、唯一の世界。

key: One where anything can happen,
en: One where anything can happen,
ja: 何もかもが起こりうる世界、

key: Whether that is everything at once, or nothing at all.
en: Whether that is everything at once, or nothing at all.
ja: それが一度にすべてであろうと、何一つなかろうと。

key: SOLARIS: Uh huh.
en: SOLARIS: Uh huh.
ja: ソラリス: ふむ。

key: My third question...
en: My third question...
ja: 三つ目の質問だ…

key: LIN: I did not agree to three questions.
en: LIN: I did not agree to three questions.
ja: リン: 三つ答えるとは言っていない。

key: VICTORIA: Thanks for coming up here for me, despite how I've acted towards you.
en: VICTORIA: Thanks for coming up here for me, despite how I've acted towards you.
ja: ヴィクトリア: わたしがあんな態度取ってたのに、ここまで来てくれてありがとう。

key: CAL: Forgiveness was a staple of our curriculum.
en: CAL: Forgiveness was a staple of our curriculum.
ja: キャル: 許しは俺たちのカリキュラムの定番だったからな。

key: I would not be who I am today without it.
en: I would not be who I am today without it.
ja: それがなかったら、今の俺はいなかったよ。

key: VICTORIA: Y-yeah...
en: VICTORIA: Y-yeah...
ja: ヴィクトリア: う、うん…

key: You really saved Kiki's Medicham, huh?
en: You really saved Kiki's Medicham, huh?
ja: 本当にキキのチャーレムを助けたんだね。

key: CAL: Yeah.
en: CAL: Yeah.
ja: キャル: ああ。

key: Do you want to meet her again?
en: Do you want to meet her again?
ja: また会いに行くか?

key: VICTORIA: Not right now.
en: VICTORIA: Not right now.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 今はいい。

key: Let's... do it back at Apophyll.
en: Let's... do it back at Apophyll.
ja: アポフィルに戻ってから…にしよう。

key: You'll come with me, right?
en: You'll come with me, right?
ja: 一緒に来てくれるよね?

key: I could use some help, between that place and Reborn City duties.
en: I could use some help, between that place and Reborn City duties.
ja: あそこの仕事とリボーンシティの仕事、両方で手伝ってほしいの。

key: CAL: After this is all over...
en: CAL: After this is all over...
ja: キャル: これが全部終わったら…

key: Yeah, I can do that.
en: Yeah, I can do that.
ja: ああ、それならできるよ。

key: But there's something I still need to do first.
en: But there's something I still need to do first.
ja: でも、その前にまだやらなきゃいけないことがある。

key: VICTORIA: Oh...
en: VICTORIA: Oh...
ja: ヴィクトリア: あ…

key: That's okay.
en: That's okay.
ja: それでいいよ。

key: Whenever you get back, then.
en: Whenever you get back, then.
ja: 戻ってきたら、その時にね。

key: It's been a long time, hasn't it...
en: It's been a long time, hasn't it...
ja: 長い時間が経ったよね…

key: CAL: I guess so.
en: CAL: I guess so.
ja: キャル: そうだな。

key: VICTORIA: Um...
en: VICTORIA: Um...
ja: ヴィクトリア: あの…

key: This--
en: This--
ja: これ――

key: Might be a little weird for me to say given how long I've been mad at you, but...
en: Might be a little weird for me to say given how long I've been mad at you, but...
ja: ずっと怒ってたのに、こんなこと言うのって変かもしれないけど…

key: Um, back then I...
en: Um, back then I...
ja: あの、あの頃わたし…

key: I really liked you.
en: I really liked you.
ja: 本当にあなたのことが好きだった。

key: Do you think...
en: Do you think...
ja: もしよかったら…

key: Maybe once things settle down...
en: Maybe once things settle down...
ja: 落ち着いたら、もしかして…

key: We could... go out, or something?
en: We could... go out, or something?
ja: その…付き合ったりとか、できないかな?

key: CAL: Oh.
en: CAL: Oh.
ja: キャル: え。

key: Uh...
en: Uh...
ja: あー…

key: This is... a little awkward.
en: This is... a little awkward.
ja: これは…ちょっと気まずいな。

key: I'm, uh...
en: I'm, uh...
ja: 俺、その…

key: Not... actually...
en: Not... actually...
ja: 実は…その…

key: ...Into women?
en: ...Into women?
ja: …女の子には興味がなくて?

key: VICTORIA: ...Oh!
en: VICTORIA: ...Oh!
ja: ヴィクトリア: …あ!

key: Oh.
en: Oh.
ja: あ。

key: Oh-- okay.
en: Oh-- okay.
ja: あ――そっか。

key: Okay, well!
en: Okay, well!
ja: そう、じゃあ!

key: It's a long trip back to Apophyll from here, so I guess I'll get started!
en: It's a long trip back to Apophyll from here, so I guess I'll get started!
ja: ここからアポフィルまで長旅だし、そろそろ出発しようかな!

key: I, uh, hope to see you around someday!
en: I, uh, hope to see you around someday!
ja: その、いつかまた会えるといいね!

key: Bye!
en: Bye!
ja: またね!

key: I'll get in touch with her later.
en: I'll get in touch with her later.
ja: 後で彼女に連絡しておこう。

key: For now...
en: For now...
ja: 今は…

key: I'll go back and look for him, I guess.
en: I'll go back and look for him, I guess.
ja: 戻って彼を探しに行くとしよう。

key: CHATOT: Chat-chat-- 'Save \PN!'
en: CHATOT: Chat-chat-- 'Save \PN!'
ja: ペラップ: ペラッ、ペラッ――『\PNを助けろ!』

key: ...Chatot!
en: ...Chatot!
ja: …ペラップ!

key: Chatot decided to come with you!
en: Chatot decided to come with you!
ja: ペラップは一緒に来ることにした!

key: All that matters is that you pick Pokémon that you enjoy playing.
en: All that matters is that you pick Pokémon that you enjoy playing.
ja: 大事なのは、自分が使ってて楽しいポケモンを選ぶことだけだ。

key: Win or lose, it's how you use their strengths.
en: Win or lose, it's how you use their strengths.
ja: 勝つにせよ負けるにせよ、大事なのはその強みをどう活かすかだ。
